portfolio.name: FRUIT ECOMMERCE SYSTEM
portfolio.description: Designed and developed a responsive Fruit Ecommerce website using ReactJS and Material UI, allowing users to browse fruits, view product details, and manage their cart. Implemented Context API for smooth component communication and Redux Toolkit with redux-thunk and redux-persist for efficient global state management and persistent user data, ensuring a fast and seamless shopping experience.
